working_definition: Antennal ORN cluster grouped by tuning receptors Ir84a, Ir31a, Ir76a and Or35a plus co-receptors Ir76b and Ir8a (Li et al. 2022 FCA, Manual Annotation).

best_match.fbbt_term: antennal olfactory receptor neuron of coeloconic sensillum
best_match.fbbt_definition: Odorant receptor neuron (ORN) whose dendrite transduces signals from a coeloconic antennal sensillum.

justification: Grouped call. Ancestry checked in OLS: Ir84a (FBbt:00110007), Ir31a (FBbt:00110010), Ir76a ac4 (FBbt:00110018) and Or35a (FBbt:00067039) are all descendants of antennal ORN of coeloconic sensillum. Ir76b and Ir8a are co-receptors, not separate types. No adult-specific coeloconic ORN term exists; the members are adult ORNs.
